title: Japanese Slam dunk poster aesthetics sports basketball canvas  painting wall art decor
description:
Japanese Slam dunk poster aesthetics sports basketball canvas painting wall art decor
Features:
Matte and waterproof durable in use and environmental protection.
Vivid and full of artistic atmosphere.

Perfect for bedroom,study,hallway,living room,etc.Nice decoration and increase elegance to your home.

How to Use ：
1.put it in your frame as High quality paintings

Material: Canvas cloth

Size: 13 * 18cm, 15 * 20cm, 20 * 25cm, 21 * 30cm 30*40cm 40*60cm 50*70cm

Shipping time ： 24-48 Hours

Package included:

1 Pc Canvas print painting (no frame)

1.Please note that this listing is for a print only without border and does not include a frame.

2.Framing options are available via an add-on listing that can be found on our shop page.
